title: Carrot Chopdown (Hard Version)
statement: A machine operation chooses a positive integer x and any set of carrots, and every chosen carrot longer than x is split into pieces of length x and the remainder. Given up to 200000 carrots with lengths bounded by m, this hard version asks, independently for every k from 1 to m, the largest number of resulting pieces that can all share one common length after exactly k operations.
